column1: # Every release build of this app, oldest first. Written by tool/build.sh, which
# appends one row after each successful build. The next build of a tier takes
# its versionName from that tier's last row and its versionCode from that
# tier's highest code. Edit by hand only to open a tier or correct history.
#   tier     staging, prod, ... Each tier has its own applicationId and bundle
#            identifier, so stores and devices count its codes separately.
#   name     versionName / CFBundleShortVersionString, shown to users
#   code     versionCode / CFBundleVersion. Never goes down within a tier.
#   git      short commit the build started from, +dirty if uncommitted
#   dep      commit of TRACKED_GIT_DEP the build compiled, or -
#   filed    artefact file names in OUT_DIR, comma-separated
#   note     free text from NOTE, or -
# OPENING A TIER: add one row by hand with the tier's current name and code.
# For an app already on a store, the code is the highest the store holds for
# that package; read it from the store console, never guess it. Mark the row
# in the note column, for example "opening row".
